what.text: This page follows refugees from Canada in all host countries, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 360 Canadian refugees, and Germany hosted 17.5% of them.
After Germany, the largest hosts are Spain, the United States and Poland.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict and no dated events for Canada, so it does not say why people left.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2007 and 2024 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series starts in 1991 at 5 refugees, and the figure was at its highest, 530, at the end of 2007.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took.
These are year-end totals summed over every host country that reported to UNHCR.
